articles.title_en: Quantifying misallocation of public housing
articles.title_cn: 量化公共住房的错配
articles.abstract_en: We empirically investigate how rent control combined with the use of a non-market allocation mechanism – centralised waiting lists – affects the efficiency of housing allocation among public-housing tenants. We show that, on average, Dutch public-housing tenants consume a house whose value differs by 7.5% from what they would consume under an efficient allocation. This entails particularly large transfers in housing consumption from younger households to older households. The annual welfare loss arising from misallocation within the public-housing sector is modest, estimated at around €65 per tenant.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们实证研究了租金管制与非市场分配机制（集中式等候名单）相结合如何影响公共住房租户之间的住房分配效率。我们表明，平均而言，荷兰公共住房租户所消费的房屋价值与在有效分配下他们本应消费的房屋价值相差7.5%。这导致了住房消费从年轻家庭向老年家庭的特别大规模转移。公共住房部门内部错配导致的年度福利损失较小，估计约为每位租户65欧元。

articles.title_en: Correlation in state and local tax changes
articles.title_cn: 州和地方税收变化的相关性
articles.abstract_en: Empirical research in public economics, including our own, often uses variation in state and local taxes as an empirical laboratory to estimate causal relationships. A key concern is that other taxes might change at the same time. To assess this concern, we develop a dataset of state (1977–2022) and local (2000–2022) tax rates and revenue from personal income, corporate income, property, sales, and excise taxes. This new dataset generates two key results. First, we find that taxes of different types tend to co-move within a jurisdiction: a tax change of one type can more than double the likelihood of a second tax type changing in the same year. Local tax changes also co-move with tax changes enacted by the state they are located in. This positive correlation can upwardly bias elasticity estimates, but only moderately. For example, regressing state economic outcomes on the full set of state tax changes yields elasticities that are about 10%–30% smaller than those obtained from using a single tax type in isolation. Second, we document that the mix of taxes across state and local jurisdictions is very different, and that these differences have become more pronounced over time as jurisdictions have increasingly become reliant on the single tax type — sales, personal or corporate income tax — that was most prominent for them in the earliest part of our sample.
articles.abstract_cn: 公共经济学中的实证研究，包括我们自己的研究，经常利用州和地方税收的变化作为实证实验室来估计因果关系。一个关键的担忧是，其他税收可能同时发生变化。为了评估这一担忧，我们构建了一个涵盖州（1977-2022年）和地方（2000-2022年）个人所得税、公司所得税、财产税、销售税和消费税税率及收入的数据集。这一新数据集产生了两个关键结果。首先，我们发现不同类型的税收往往在同一辖区内共同变动：一种税收类型的变化可能使另一种税收类型在同一年发生变化的可能性增加一倍以上。地方税收变化也与其所在州实施的税收变化共同变动。这种正相关性可能会向上偏误弹性估计，但幅度适中。例如，将州经济结果对全部州税收变化进行回归，得到的弹性比单独使用单一税收类型所得的弹性小约10%至30%。其次，我们记录了州和地方辖区之间的税收组合差异很大，并且随着辖区日益依赖单一税收类型——销售税、个人所得税或公司所得税——这些差异随时间变得更加明显，而这一单一税收类型在样本早期阶段对它们来说最为突出。

articles.title_en: Student development in teacher–student interaction: Evidence from a randomized experiment in online education
articles.title_cn: 师生互动中的学生发展：来自在线教育随机实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study conducts the first investigation of how the teacher–student interaction in online education impacts the academic achievements and personality traits of primary school students using a field experiment. Our findings indicate that adding regular interactive online recitation sessions to pure online courses leads to significant improvements in students’ exam scores, as well as increased levels of extraversion, openness, and conscientiousness. The positive effects on students’ academic achievements and personality traits can be attributed to students’ enhanced learning motivation and engagement and increased levels of parental inputs, respectively.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究首次通过实地实验探讨了在线教育中师生互动对小学生学业成绩和个性特质的影响。我们的研究结果表明，在纯在线课程中加入定期的互动式在线背诵环节，能显著提高学生的考试成绩，并增强其外向性、开放性和尽责性水平。对学生学业成绩和个性特质的积极影响可分别归因于学生学习动机和参与度的提升，以及家长投入的增加。

articles.title_en: The environmental cost of power outages: Evidence from Delhi
articles.title_cn: 停电的环境成本：来自德里的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines an overlooked consequence of an unstable electricity supply: air pollution. Using a unique dataset with high-frequency records of outage events and pollution, we find that outages lead to a 0.4% and 1.3% increase in hourly NO2 and NO concentrations and a 0.4% increase in PM10 levels. This is likely attributable to the widespread use of highly polluting backup diesel generators. The environmental cost of outages exceeds the private cost for users when backup generators are adopted. Welfare analysis using bunching estimation highlights the importance of incorporating environmental benefits in the evaluation of policies aimed at mitigating outages.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了电力供应不稳定一个被忽视的后果：空气污染。利用包含停电事件和污染高频记录的独特数据集，我们发现停电导致每小时NO2和NO浓度分别增加0.4%和1.3%，PM10水平增加0.4%。这可能归因于高污染备用柴油发电机的广泛使用。当采用备用发电机时，停电的环境成本超过用户的私人成本。使用聚束估计的福利分析强调了在评估旨在缓解停电的政策时纳入环境效益的重要性。

articles.title_en: The big sell: Privatizing East Germany’s economy
articles.title_cn: 大甩卖：东德经济的私有化
articles.abstract_en: Departing from communism, East Germany witnessed history’s most extensive privatization program. While the program sparked global interest as a blueprint for economic transformation, its effectiveness remains disputed. Using unique firm-level data, we examine the program’s objective to privatize the most competitive firms. We document that firms with higher baseline productivity are more likely to be privatized, yield higher prices, are more often acquired by West Germans, and are more likely to survive 20 years later. Inspecting the inner workings of the privatization agency, we illustrate challenges and lessons for how governments can design and implement industrial policy goals.
articles.abstract_cn: 脱离共产主义后，东德见证了历史上最广泛的私有化计划。尽管该计划作为经济转型的蓝图引起了全球关注，但其有效性仍存争议。利用独特的企业层面数据，我们考察了该计划旨在私有化最具竞争力企业的目标。我们记录到，基线生产率较高的企业更有可能被私有化，获得更高的价格，更常被西德人收购，并且在20年后更有可能存活。通过审视私有化机构的内部运作，我们阐述了政府如何设计和实施产业政策目标的挑战与教训。

articles.title_en: Labor market regulations and firm adjustments in skill demand
articles.title_cn: 劳动力市场规制与企业技能需求的调整
articles.abstract_en: We study how changes in labor market regulations may trigger firm adjustments in skill demand. Leveraging rich administrative data from Italy, we investigate the effects of a reform that, to increase job stability, reduced the firing costs for permanent employees and tightened the regulation of fixed-term contracts. Using a difference-in-differences (DID) design, we document that the reform had unintended effects, inducing firms to increase layoffs of low-skilled (LS) permanent employees and reduce hires of LS workers on fixed-term contracts. However, the reform had no effect on high-skilled workers or permanent hires. A theoretical search and matching model with heterogeneous skills and contract durations makes sense of our main findings.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了劳动力市场规制的变化如何引发企业在技能需求上的调整。利用意大利丰富的行政数据，我们考察了一项旨在提高工作稳定性、降低永久雇员解雇成本并收紧固定期限合同规制的改革的影响。采用双重差分（DID）设计，我们记录了该改革产生的意外效应，促使企业增加对低技能（LS）永久雇员的解雇，并减少对低技能工人的固定期限合同雇佣。然而，该改革对高技能工人或永久雇佣没有影响。一个包含异质性技能和合同期限的理论搜索与匹配模型解释了我们的主要发现。

articles.title_en: How do business owners respond to a tax cut? Examining the 199A deduction for pass-through firms
articles.title_cn: 企业主如何应对减税？考察穿透企业的199A扣除
articles.abstract_en: We measure the responses of businesses and their owners to Section 199A, a deduction that reduced the effective tax rate on most U.S. pass-through business income beginning in 2018. Using tax records of individuals and businesses, we compare taxpayers with exogenously differing levels of exposure to the deduction, exploiting limitations within the statute. We find evidence of a 3 to 4 percent increase in reported business income eligible for the deduction during 2018 and 2019 for the more-exposed group relative to the less-exposed group. We also find some evidence of effects on specific hypothesized margins of adjustment. Partnerships reduced ineligible forms of compensation paid to owners by approximately 10 to 15 percent, in line with the incentives created by Section 199A, but S corporations did not reduce wages to owners. We find no evidence that Section 199A encouraged movements from employee to contractor status or increased contractor activity. Finally, we find little evidence of changes in real economic activity as measured by physical investment, wages to non-owners, or employment.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们衡量了企业和其所有者对第199A条款的反应，该条款自2018年起降低了大多数美国穿透企业商业收入的有效税率。利用个人和企业的税务记录，我们比较了因法规限制而面临不同扣除暴露程度的纳税人。我们发现，在2018和2019年，相对于暴露程度较低的群体，暴露程度较高的群体报告的可享受扣除的商业收入增加了3至4%。我们还发现了一些对特定假设调整边际的影响证据。合伙企业减少了支付给所有者的不合格补偿形式，大约减少了10至15%，这与第199A条款产生的激励一致，但S公司并未减少支付给所有者的工资。我们没有发现第199A条款鼓励从雇员身份向承包商身份转变或增加承包商活动的证据。最后，我们几乎没有发现实际经济活动变化的证据，这些活动以实物投资、非所有者工资或就业来衡量。

articles.title_en: Between a rock and a hard place: The costs and benefits of expanded unemployment insurance benefits
articles.title_cn: 进退两难：扩大失业保险福利的成本与收益
articles.abstract_en: We examine how the withdrawal of the largest expansion of unemployment insurance (UI) benefits in United States history affected job-finding, demand for other government assistance, and credit defaults. Using administrative UI data merged with credit records and applications for Medicaid and SNAP, we show that UI withdrawal led to an increase in job-finding that was most pronounced among financially constrained individuals with limited available credit. The cost savings from higher job-finding came at the expense of increased demand for other government services and higher defaults. Our results highlight an important interaction between UI, household finances, and other social insurance programs.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了美国历史上最大规模的失业保险（UI）福利撤销如何影响求职、对其他政府援助的需求以及信用违约。利用与信用记录及医疗补助和SNAP申请记录相匹配的行政UI数据，我们表明，UI撤销导致求职增加，这一效应在可用信贷有限的财务受限个体中最为显著。因求职增加而节省的成本，是以对其他政府服务需求的增加和更高的违约率为代价的。我们的结果凸显了UI、家庭财务与其他社会保险项目之间的重要互动。

articles.title_en: Financial market exposure increases generalized trust
articles.title_cn: 金融市场参与提升普遍信任
articles.abstract_en: How can we build trust, especially in polarized societies? We propose that exposure to broad financial markets—where individuals place their assets in the hands of large groups of unfamiliar agents who nonetheless have the incentive and ability to promote their interests—can contribute to generalized trust. In a randomized controlled trial, we encourage Israelis to hold or trade stocks for up to seven weeks. We find that participation in financial markets increases the probability of expressing generalized trust by about 6 percentage points, equivalent to a quarter of the control group mean. The effects seem to be driven by political partisans along the left–right spectrum in Israel, and are robust to negative price changes. Thus, trust is not only a cause but can also be an effect of participation in financial markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们如何建立信任，尤其是在两极分化的社会中？我们提出，参与广泛的金融市场——个人将资产交由大量不熟悉的代理人管理，而这些代理人既有激励也有能力促进其利益——可能有助于提升普遍信任。在一项随机对照试验中，我们鼓励以色列人持有或交易股票长达七周。我们发现，参与金融市场使表达普遍信任的概率提高了约6个百分点，相当于对照组均值的四分之一。这些效应似乎由以色列左右政治光谱中的党派人士驱动，并且对负面价格变化具有稳健性。因此，信任不仅是参与金融市场的原因，也可能是其结果。

articles.title_en: The psychological gains from COVID-19 vaccination
articles.title_cn: COVID-19疫苗接种带来的心理收益
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the impact of COVID-19 vaccination on psychological well-being using information from a large-scale panel survey representative of the UK population. Exploiting exogenous variation in the timing of vaccinations, we find that vaccination increases psychological well-being (GHQ-12) by 0.12 standard deviations, compensating for one-half of the deterioration in mental health caused by the pandemic. This improvement persists for at least two months, and is linked to higher engagement in social activities and a decrease in the self-reported likelihood of contracting COVID-19. The main beneficiaries are individuals who became mentally distressed during the pandemic, supporting their prioritization in vaccination roll-outs. Conversely, individuals who harbored concerns about potential vaccine side effects show no improvement in psychological well-being upon vaccination, underscoring the importance of public confidence in vaccine safety and efficacy. Accounting for the improvement in psychological well-being increases the benefits of vaccination by around 50%.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用一项代表英国人口的大规模面板调查数据，估计了COVID-19疫苗接种对心理健康的影响。利用疫苗接种时间的外生变化，我们发现接种疫苗使心理健康（GHQ-12）提高0.12个标准差，弥补了疫情导致的心理健康恶化的一半。这种改善至少持续两个月，并与更高的社交活动参与度和自我报告的感染COVID-19可能性降低相关。主要受益者是在疫情期间出现心理困扰的个体，这支持了在疫苗接种推广中优先考虑他们。相反，对潜在疫苗副作用有顾虑的个体在接种后心理健康没有改善，这强调了公众对疫苗安全性和有效性信心的必要性。考虑到心理健康的改善，疫苗接种的收益增加了约50%。

articles.title_en: The effect of a ‘None of the above’ ballot paper option on voting behavior and election outcomes
articles.title_cn: 选票上“以上皆非”选项对投票行为与选举结果的影响
articles.abstract_en: We study how an explicit blank vote option “None of the above” (NOTA) on the ballot paper affects the behavior of voters and political candidates as well as election results. In a series of survey and laboratory experiments we identify a tradeoff regarding making NOTA an explicit voting option. On the one hand it can reduce the vote share of candidates who voters consider as protest candidates, who often come from the extremes of the political spectrum, making it less likely that such a protest candidate wins the election. On the other hand, anticipating the above effect, establishment candidates may care less about the electorate when NOTA is on the ballot. Evidence on voters’ reaction to NOTA comes from two online survey experiments conducted in the weeks preceding the 2016 U.S. presidential election and the 2016 Austrian run-off election for president. Participants were subjected to either the original ballot paper or to a ballot paper where we added a NOTA option. We investigate the dynamic response of politicians to the presence of NOTA in a laboratory experiment in which an establishment candidate can decide between selfish and fair policy proposals and voters can choose between the establishment candidate and an inefficient protest option.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究选票上明确的空白投票选项“以上皆非”（NOTA）如何影响选民和政治候选人的行为以及选举结果。通过一系列调查和实验室实验，我们识别了将NOTA设为明确投票选项所涉及的权衡。一方面，它可以降低选民视为抗议候选人的得票率，这些候选人往往来自政治光谱的极端，从而降低此类抗议候选人赢得选举的可能性。另一方面，预见到上述效应，当选票上有NOTA时，建制派候选人可能对选民关注较少。关于选民对NOTA反应的证据来自两次在线调查实验，分别在2016年美国总统选举前几周和2016年奥地利总统决选前几周进行。参与者被随机分配至原始选票或我们添加了NOTA选项的选票。我们在实验室实验中调查了政治家对NOTA存在的动态反应，其中一名建制派候选人可以在自私和公平的政策提案之间做出选择，而选民可以在建制派候选人和低效的抗议选项之间进行选择。

articles.title_en: Reducing child marriages through CCTs: Evidence from a large-scale policy intervention in Indonesia
articles.title_cn: 通过有条件现金转移减少童婚：来自印度尼西亚大规模政策干预的证据
articles.abstract_en: There is limited empirical evidence on whether poverty-targeted conditional cash transfers (CCTs) can be an effective tool in reducing child marriages. Employing a Fuzzy Regression Discontinuity design that uses administrative roll-out data matched to the government’s poverty census and targeting database in Indonesia, we estimate that the country’s flagship CCT (PKH) reduced child marriages of girls in rural Indonesia by about 3.5 percentage points (about 40 percent). We conclude that CCTs may help break the persistent practice of child marriages.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于针对贫困的有条件现金转移（CCTs）能否有效减少童婚的实证证据有限。利用模糊断点回归设计，结合印度尼西亚政府的贫困普查和瞄准数据库的行政推广数据，我们估计该国旗舰CCT项目（PKH）将印度尼西亚农村地区女孩的童婚率降低了约3.5个百分点（约40%）。我们得出结论，CCTs可能有助于打破童婚的持续实践。

articles.title_en: The Intergenerational Health Effects of Forced Displacement: Japanese American Incarceration during WWII
articles.title_cn: 强制迁移的代际健康效应：二战期间日裔美国人的监禁
articles.abstract_en: We study the intergenerational health consequences of forced displacement and incarceration of Japanese Americans in the US during WWII. Incarcerated mothers had babies who were less healthy at birth. This decrease in health represents a shift in the entire birthweight distribution due to exposure to prison camps. Imprisoned individuals were less likely to have children with fathers of other ethnic groups but were more likely to invest in education, and participate in the labor market. Despite these positive human capital effects, overall we find a negative effect of incarceration on intergenerational health.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了二战期间美国日裔美国人被迫迁移和监禁的代际健康后果。被监禁的母亲所生的婴儿出生时健康状况较差。这种健康下降代表了整个出生体重分布因暴露于监狱营而发生的转变。被监禁的个体不太可能与其他族裔的父亲生育子女，但更可能投资于教育并参与劳动力市场。尽管这些人力资本效应是积极的，但总体而言，我们发现监禁对代际健康有负面影响。

articles.title_en: How in-person conversations shape political polarization: Quasi-experimental evidence from a nationwide initiative
articles.title_cn: 面对面交谈如何影响政治极化：来自全国性倡议的准实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Growing political polarization is often attributed to “echo chambers” among like-minded individuals and a lack of social interactions among contrary-minded individuals. We provide quasi-experimental evidence on the effects of in-person conversations on individual-level polarization outcomes, studying a large-scale intervention in Germany that matched pairs of strangers for private face-to-face meetings to discuss divisive political issues. We find asymmetric effects: conversations with like-minded individuals caused political views to become more extreme (ideological polarization); by contrast, conversations with contrary-minded individuals did not lead to a convergence of political views, but significantly reduced negative beliefs and attitudes toward ideological out-group members (affective polarization), while also improving perceived social cohesion more generally. These effects of contrary-minded conversations seem to be driven mostly by positive experiences of interpersonal contact.
articles.abstract_cn: 日益加剧的政治极化常被归因于志同道合者之间的“回音室”效应以及异见者之间缺乏社会互动。我们通过研究德国一项大规模干预措施，提供了面对面交谈对个体层面极化结果影响的准实验证据，该干预措施将陌生两人配对进行私下面对面会议，讨论有争议的政治议题。我们发现不对称效应：与志同道合者的交谈导致政治观点变得更加极端（意识形态极化）；相比之下，与异见者的交谈并未导致政治观点的趋同，但显著减少了对意识形态外群体成员的负面信念和态度（情感极化），同时总体上改善了感知到的社会凝聚力。异见交谈的这些效应似乎主要由人际接触的积极体验驱动。

articles.title_en: Learning the hard way: Conflicts, sanctions and military aid
articles.title_cn: 艰难学习：冲突、制裁与军事援助
articles.abstract_en: Countries involved in conflicts learn about their military strength from the battlefield. We study how a third party intervenes to manipulate this learning. An attacker and a defender engage in a conflict whose outcome conveys information about the attacker’s strength. A third party worries that the attacker becomes more confident about its military strength and can intervene to help the defender. This intervention is risky: if the attacker wins despite the help the defender receives, its confidence increases even further. We show that optimal third-party intervention is non-monotonic in the attacker’s strength. We also show that a high level of patriotism and resolve to defend itself improve the defender’s odds in the conflict by inducing third-party intervention.
articles.abstract_cn: 卷入冲突的国家从战场上了解其军事力量。我们研究第三方如何干预以操纵这种学习过程。攻击方和防御方进行一场冲突，其结果传递关于攻击方实力的信息。第三方担心攻击方对其军事力量变得更加自信，并可能干预以帮助防御方。这种干预是有风险的：如果攻击方尽管得到了防御方的帮助仍获胜，其信心会进一步增加。我们表明，最优的第三方干预在攻击方实力上是非单调的。我们还表明，高度的爱国精神和自卫决心通过诱导第三方干预来提高防御方在冲突中的胜算。

articles.title_en: The impact of standardized disease-specific healthcare coverage
articles.title_cn: 标准化疾病特定医疗覆盖的影响
articles.abstract_en: We study the impact of a healthcare reform that standardized procedures and timely coverage of a set of diseases. Using Chile’s universe of death records and a difference-in-differences research design, we show that mortality from the diseases covered by this reform decreased by 4.4% on average. Disease-specific shocks or a resource shift from non-covered to covered diseases do not explain this effect. Evidence from polytraumatized inpatients suggests that the reform equalized utilization rates as it reduced the dispersion of risk-adjusted surgery rates and spending across hospitals.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一项医疗改革的影响，该改革标准化了特定疾病组的程序和及时覆盖。利用智利的全量死亡记录和双重差分研究设计，我们表明，该改革覆盖的疾病死亡率平均下降了4.4%。特定疾病的冲击或资源从非覆盖疾病向覆盖疾病的转移并不能解释这一效应。来自多发性创伤住院患者的证据表明，改革通过降低各医院风险调整手术率和支出的离散度，使利用率趋于均等化。

articles.title_en: The decline of manufacturing employment and the rise of the far-right in Austria
articles.title_cn: 制造业就业的衰退与奥地利极右翼的崛起
articles.abstract_en: In recent decades, right-wing populist parties have experienced increased electoral success in many Western democracies. This rise of the far-right, which is strongly built on the support of the working class, coincides with a sharp decline of the manufacturing sector. This paper analyzes the contribution of this manufacturing decline to the rise of the Austrian far-right. Overall, the decline in manufacturing employment has strongly contributed to this rightward shift in the political landscape, with the manufacturing decline explaining around one-third of the observed increase in far-right vote-shares between 1995 and 2019. Regarding the influences of the forces underlying the manufacturing decline, namely international trade and automation technologies, suggests that both forces contributed in roughly equal parts to this development.
articles.abstract_cn: 近几十年来，右翼民粹主义政党在许多西方民主国家中获得了越来越多的选举成功。这种极右翼的崛起，强烈建立在工人阶级的支持之上，恰逢制造业部门的急剧衰退。本文分析了这种制造业衰退对奥地利极右翼崛起的贡献。总体而言，制造业就业的衰退强烈促进了政治格局中的这种右倾转变，其中制造业衰退解释了1995年至2019年间观察到的极右翼选票份额增加的大约三分之一。关于制造业衰退背后的力量影响，即国际贸易和自动化技术，表明这两种力量对这一发展贡献大致相等。

articles.title_en: Housing Improvement and Crime
articles.title_cn: 住房改善与犯罪
articles.abstract_en: We evaluate a policy implemented in Chicago geared towards improving the private housing stock in distressed neighborhoods. First, the program successfully increased housing renovations and reduced foreclosures, demonstrating tangible housing improvements. Next, treated areas experienced significant reductions in burglaries and robberies, with adjacent neighborhoods also documenting similar decreases in crime. We do not find evidence that gentrification with displacement of incumbent residents is responsible for the positive impacts of the program. Our findings provide evidence of substantial neighborhood gains from low-cost, place-based housing interventions that prioritize the preservation of existing housing stock.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们评估了一项在芝加哥实施的政策，该政策旨在改善贫困社区的私人住房存量。首先，该项目成功增加了住房翻新并减少了止赎，显示出切实的住房改善。其次，受处理区域 burglaries 和 robberies 显著减少，邻近社区也记录了类似的犯罪下降。我们没有发现证据表明，伴随原住民搬迁的绅士化是该项目积极影响的原因。我们的研究结果提供了证据，表明以保护现有住房存量为优先的低成本、基于地点的住房干预措施能带来可观的社区收益。

articles.title_en: Neighborhoods, perceived Inequality, and preferences for Redistribution: Evidence from Barcelona
articles.title_cn: 邻里、感知不平等与再分配偏好：来自巴塞罗那的证据
articles.abstract_en: I study the effects of neighborhood-level inequality on perceived national-level inequality and preferences for redistribution. I construct a novel measure of local inequality using geolocated housing data and elicit perceptions and preferences from an original survey conducted in Barcelona. Local inequality is positively associated with perceived inequality but not with preferences for redistribution. I address endogenous sorting by exploiting quasi-random variation in exposure to new apartment buildings; this increases perceived inequality by 7% and has a positive but not statistically significant effect on demand for redistribution. Effects come from higher perceived income at the top. Local inequality shapes national-level inequality perceptions, but if it influences demand for redistribution, the effect is small. This work suggests that individuals extrapolate from their local environments when forming beliefs and highlights the importance of data granularity when studying neighborhood effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了邻里层面的不平等对感知的国家层面不平等及再分配偏好的影响。我利用地理定位的住房数据构建了一个新颖的地方不平等度量，并通过在巴塞罗那进行的原始调查来获取感知和偏好。地方不平等与感知不平等正相关，但与再分配偏好无关。我通过利用新公寓楼暴露的准随机变化来解决内生性排序问题；这使感知不平等增加了7%，但对再分配需求有正向但不具有统计显著性的影响。影响来自对顶层收入感知的提高。地方不平等塑造了国家层面的不平等感知，但如果它影响再分配需求，其效应也是微小的。这项工作表明，个体在形成信念时会从其当地环境中进行推断，并强调了在研究邻里效应时数据粒度的重要性。

articles.title_en: Parents’ effective time endowment and divorce: Evidence from extended school days
articles.title_cn: 父母的有效时间禀赋与离婚：来自延长学校日的证据
articles.abstract_en: Policies that extend the school day in elementary school provide an implicit childcare subsidy for families. As such, they can affect parents’ time allocation and family dynamics. This paper examines how extending the school day affects families by focusing on marriage dissolution. We exploit the staggered adoption of a policy that extended the availability of full-time elementary schools across different municipalities in Mexico. Using administrative data on divorces, we find that extending the school day by 3.5 h leads to a significant increase in divorce rates. Moreover, the effect grows with every year of municipalities’ exposure to full-time schooling. The effects are largely driven by municipalities with non-traditional social norms about marriage, divorce, and women’s priority to jobs, and by women in households with school-age children. Increased female labor force participation due to the availability of childcare is likely to be one of the mechanisms that relaxed restrictions on marriage dissolution.
articles.abstract_cn: 延长小学学校日的政策为家庭提供了隐性儿童保育补贴。因此，它们可以影响父母的时间分配和家庭动态。本文通过关注婚姻解体来研究延长学校日如何影响家庭。我们利用了墨西哥不同城市逐步采用延长全日制小学可用性的政策。利用离婚行政数据，我们发现将学校日延长3.5小时会导致离婚率显著上升。此外，随着城市接触全日制教育的年限增加，这种效应逐年增强。这些影响主要由关于婚姻、离婚和女性就业优先权的非传统社会规范的城市，以及有学龄儿童家庭中的女性驱动。由于儿童保育的可用性而导致的女性劳动力参与率增加，可能是放松婚姻解体限制的机制之一。

articles.title_en: Nothing for something: Marketing cancer drugs to physicians increases prescribing without improving mortality
articles.title_cn: 无谓的付出：向医生推销抗癌药物增加处方量但未改善死亡率
articles.abstract_en: Physicians commonly receive marketing-related transfers from drug firms. We examine the impact of these relationships on the prescribing of physician-administered cancer drugs in Medicare. We find that prescribing of the associated drug increases 4% in the twelve months after a payment is received, with the increase beginning sharply in the month of payment and fading out within a year. A marketing payment also leads physicians to begin treating cancer patients with lower predicted mortality. While payments result in greater expenditure on cancer drugs, there are no associated improvements in patient mortality.
articles.abstract_cn: 医生通常接受来自制药公司的营销相关转移支付。我们研究了这些关系对医疗保险中医生管理的抗癌药物处方的影响。我们发现，在收到付款后的十二个月内，相关药物的处方量增加了4%，这一增长在付款当月急剧开始，并在一年内逐渐消退。营销支付还导致医生开始治疗预测死亡率较低的癌症患者。虽然支付导致抗癌药物支出增加，但患者死亡率并未得到相应改善。

articles.title_en: The environmental costs of political interference: Evidence from power plants in the Amazon
articles.title_cn: 政治干预的环境成本：来自亚马逊发电厂的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper estimates the impacts of ten recently built hydroelectric power plants in the Brazilian Amazon on deforestation. Using the inventory of all sites with undeveloped hydropower potential, we apply the synthetic control method to estimate the causal impact of each power plant on forest loss. Overall, the construction of the ten plants contributed to 13 percent of the observed forest loss within a 50-kilometer radius of the construction site. Notably, this impact is solely attributed to four plants. In at least three of these plants, construction licenses were granted despite technical recommendations against them. In contrast, the remaining plants, which received technical clearance from the environmental agency, have negligible effects. These findings highlight the effectiveness of robust environmental regulations and underscore their vulnerability to high-level political interference.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文估计了巴西亚马逊地区最近建成的十座水力发电厂对森林砍伐的影响。利用所有具有未开发水电潜力的地点的清单，我们应用综合控制方法来估计每个发电厂对森林损失的因果影响。总体而言，十座工厂的建设造成了施工地点半径 50 公里内观察到的森林损失的 13%。值得注意的是，这种影响仅归因于四家工厂。尽管存在技术建议，但其中至少三座工厂仍获得了施工许可证。相比之下，其余获得环境机构技术许可的工厂的影响可以忽略不计。这些发现凸显了强有力的环境法规的有效性，并强调了它们容易受到高层政治干预的影响。
